dreamSkin.import.title: Use your own image
dreamSkin.import.description: Import a pure PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, or TIFF background and let the renderer adapt the palette and composition locally.
dreamSkin.import.modalDescription: Tune how the artwork sits behind the native Codex interface. Auto is the safest default for most images.
dreamSkin.import.name: Theme name
dreamSkin.overlayOpacity.description: Higher values make the conversation background overlay stronger.
dreamSkin.import.requirements: Use edge-to-edge artwork without window chrome, UI, readable text, logos, or watermarks. Prepared images are limited to 16 MB, 16384 px per side, and 50 megapixels.
dreamSkin.saved.title: Saved themes
dreamSkin.saved.subtitle: Imported and named themes remain here for quick switching.
dreamSkin.saved.description: A locally saved Dream Skin theme.
dreamSkin.saved.delete.confirmDescriptio: The selected themes will be removed from this device.
dreamSkin.tools.title: Apply, inspect, or roll back safely
dreamSkin.tools.description: These controls use the migrated Dream Skin scripts and retain their path, image, process-identity, CDP, and configuration safeguards.
dreamSkin.restore.confirmDescription: This removes the current skin and restarts Codex with its original appearance. Model switching remains available.
dreamSkin.save.description: Create another reusable card from the active theme and its current image settings.
